text:
Olivia: tiny holiday PSA — who wants a 15-min 'mini-tinsel painting' contest + mismatch-socks showdown next Thursday? thinking something low-fi and fun during lunch. anyone up for cookie swap after? :sparkles::tada:

Mateo: count me in for tinsel painting. i paint exactly 0 things well but that's the point :joy:

Anna: mismatch socks are my entire aesthetic. i'll bring a box of cookies (gluten-free option included). what time?

Kevin: i can do 12:30 PT. timezone heads up: i'm in PST. also voting for 'tiny tree desk parade' as tie-breaker option.

Sasha: 12:30 PT works. can we do signups like this: "Name — event — cookie type"? keeps it simple.

Olivia: love that. signup format (copy/paste):
```
Name — mini-tinsel painting OR mismatch-socks OR tiny-tree parade — cookie type (optional)
```

Devbot: Reminder scheduled: "Mini holiday drop-in" Thu 12:30 PT — will post calendar invite.

Mateo: Mateo — mini-tinsel painting — chocolate chip

Anna: Anna — mismatch-socks — peanut-free sugar cookies

Kevin: Kevin — tiny-tree parade — ginger snaps

Sasha: Sasha — mini-tinsel painting — oatmeal raisin (i know, controversial)

Olivia: ok i'm adding a tiny prize: winner gets one of the office's legendary novelty mugs. also, if you want to do a 30-sec carol karaoke after, react with a :microphone: and i'll queue a playlist.

Mateo: :microphone: yes please. i'll duel anyone on 'Jingle Bell Rock'

Anna: GIF battle for best desk decoration? i'll post mine tomorrow. :camera_with_flash:

Kevin: can someone bring spare tiny tinsel? i have none. :sob:

Olivia: i'll bring extras + a small glitter containment plan (learned from past mistakes). also putting a gentle ask: if you're bringing food, drop allergy notes in the signup line.

Sasha: quick poll then — which tiny theme should be the default backdrop? reply with emoji: :sparkles: for fairy lights, :evergreen_tree: for mini tree, :star2: for window lights.

Mateo: :evergreen_tree:

Anna: :sparkles:

Kevin: :star2:

Olivia: tally so far — tree: 1, fairy lights: 1, window lights: 1. democracy!

Devbot: Calendar invite posted. RSVP there or reply here.

Olivia: perfect. thanks everyone — see you in tinsel town. (and please, keep glitter to the designated bucket.) :pray::tinsel:
